name: probe-experts-split-coefficient-scale
hypothesis: Retain both learned cubic and warp components but give their four/two coefficients separate roundedFP16 quantization scales. Archived terminal geometry has warp-dominated shared scales in53.93% of charts, and separated packing reduces cubic coefficient RMS quantization error from4.7435e-5 to3.2116e-5. Test whether reduced cross-component packing interference improves loss/time; this is coefficient accuracy, not a speed-win claim.
cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
hardware_change_scope: Opt-in shared nongrouped FP8 GEMM tiles across attention, dense MLP and output head; default MLP dispatch remains legacy.
evaluation_protocol: Capture live stage-two YaRN frequencies/attention scales on first reach of640/1408 windows. For terminal stage four or full-schedule completion only, restore those nonlearned buffers and use640/1408 evaluation arguments. Preserve raw learned weights, training schedule and all updates; no canonical mask, tail shipping or final window extension. Early-stage evaluation remains incompatible. All restoration/rebuild/readback/setup is inside original training timer; no strict qualification if actual elapsed exceeds902.3592145430011.

split_scale_evidence.cost_gate_reason: Predeclared at most2% original-model prefix cost increase for a coefficient-accuracy hypothesis. Not a claim of speed improvement; final qualification remains actual continuous900s loss.
split_scale_evidence.scope: Only KS3 coefficient quantization and matching smoothSTE use separate groups. Both components remain trainable; original rates, GS32 activations/projections, BF16 products, FP16 nonlinearity and all original dense/shared kernels remain.
split_scale_evidence.limitations: Coefficient-error reduction is not activation/loss improvement. Fixed-warp retraining was rejected, so do not infer that removing the warp helps. Initial function remains original; nonzero coefficient precision intentionally changes.
